title: From Individual to Social Imitation: How Communities Expand Organizational Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.28675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence illustrates a broader organizational puzzle: young, resource-constrained firms can build on knowledge produced across a wider field to address problems that exceed their internal experience. We theorize one mechanism as social imitation: a distributed and recursive process through which communities observe practices and outcomes across organizations, distill recurrent elements into portable strategies, circulate them, and revise the collective repertoire as adoption produces new evidence. This perspective endogenizes the object of imitation. Organizations do not merely copy practices; communities collectively produce what becomes available to copy.   We distinguish the source of a candidate (directly observed organizations or a collective) from its mode of adoption (blind or informed), and examine four forms of imitation in an agent-based model of organizational search. translated_title: 从个体模仿到社会模仿：社区如何拓展组织搜索
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能揭示了一个更广泛的组织难题：年轻的、资源受限的企业能够建立在更广泛领域中产生的知识之上，去解决超出其内部经验的问题。我们将其中一种机制理论化为“社会模仿”：这是一个分布式的、递归的过程，社区通过这一过程观察跨组织的实践与结果，将反复出现的要素提炼为可移植的策略，加以传播流通，并随着采纳产生的新证据不断修订集体策略库。这一视角将模仿的对象内生化——组织不仅仅是复制实践，社区本身在集体性地生产可供复制的内容。我们区分了候选方案的来源（直接观察到的组织或集体）与其采纳模式（盲目采纳或知情采纳），并在一个组织搜索的基于智能体模型中考察了四种模仿形式。
tldr: 该论文提出“社会模仿”理论，即社区通过观察、提炼和传播跨组织的实践形成不断演进的集体策略库，使资源受限的年轻企业能够借助超越自身内部经验的广泛知识开展组织搜索，并通过区分模仿来源与采纳模式构建了四种模仿形式的计算模型。
en_tdlr: The paper theorizes "social imitation"—a distributed, recursive process through which communities observe, distill, and circulate cross-organizational practices into an evolving collective repertoire—enabling young, resource-constrained firms to expand organizational search beyond their internal experience.
